About

À propos

Praxis LS est créé par une équipe qui a exploité des entreprises de transit en Afrique centrale. Nous avons construit l'outil dont nous avions toujours besoin et que nous n'avions jamais trouvé — un outil qui parle nativement OHADA, qui traite le grand livre comme la colonne vertébrale de l'exploitation, et qu'un directeur financier peut auditer sans demander de rapport à personne.

Why we built this

We operated freight forwarding companies in Central Africa for a decade. Every month, we spent days reconstructing the accounts from exported spreadsheets and WhatsApp threads. The DSF was assembled by hand, with margins that nobody could explain.

We looked for a tool that could run the operation and the accounting in one system — one that spoke OHADA natively, where every invoice posted itself to the ledger, where month-end was a re-reading rather than a reconstruction. It didn't exist.

So we built it.

What we believe

The ledger is the spine

Every operation — every transit file, every warehouse receipt, every fleet trip — should post to the same ledger. Not at month-end. At the moment it happens.

OHADA first

The OHADA zone is seventeen states with a common accounting framework. Building for it properly — SYSCOHADA classes, DSF, liasse fiscale — is a moat that no global vendor will cross.

Your data, your exit

One database per customer. Your credentials. Your data residency. If you ever need to leave, the export is clean and complete.

Honest marketing

We publish what is live today and what we are building. A stale row on the standards table costs more than the page earns.
